CreateDseFunctionWithType returnsType(@NonNull
                                               DataType dataType)
        Adds RETURNS to the create function specification. This is used to specify what type is returned from the function.

        To create the data type, use the constants and static methods in DataTypes, or SchemaBuilder.udt(CqlIdentifier, boolean).
